name: HAC++
definition: Anchor-based compression that couples unorganized Scaffold-GS anchors with a binarized structured hash grid, using their mutual information plus intra-anchor context for entropy modeling.
summary: HAC++ is an anchor-based compression method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that achieves 100x size reduction by coupling unorganized anchors with a binarized hash grid for sophisticated context modeling.
